title: Integral compact-support coefficient data
statement: The coefficient data of the integral compact-support comparison, in the setting of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison] (global finite-field datum [def-pur-conventions], $\ell\ne p$, finite extensions $E\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]): a coefficient system consists of a sheaf of rings $R_W$ on each pro-etale site together with inverse-image identifications $u^{-1}R_W\simeq R_{W'}$ for the maps of schemes, compatible with composition; a change of coefficients $R\to S$ is a compatible family of ring maps. For an open immersion $j$ the exact open coefficient square gives the open extension, its adjunction and the open restriction map. The image functor is the separately derived proper direct image after exact extension by zero, $P_R=Rp_*j_!$ for a compactification $f=pj$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-weil-extension-by-zero, def-weil-derived-direct-image]; the restriction and comparison are the derived change-of-rings maps $M\otimes^L_{R}S$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on the compact-support images, with the geometric pull/push composition identifications and the open projection inverse. The projection map is the canonical compact-support projection $P_R(M)\otimes^L K\to P_R(M\otimes^L f^*K)$ built from these comparisons [def-exchange-projection]. The completed coefficient system is $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$ with the completed pullback maps [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and the finite system is $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with its projection to the completed system. These are the objects named in the statements; the comparison isomorphism $c_{F/E}$ and its properties are the content of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison].
